title: i18next-parser is deprecated
summary: npm marks i18next-parser as deprecated: "Project is deprecated, use i18next-cli instead"

constraints: Preserve the extracted keys, namespaces, default values, plural forms, and catalog layout the project already uses.

steps.title: Replace the extraction tool
steps.instructions: Replace i18next-parser with i18next-cli in devDependencies and update the extraction script that runs it.

steps.title: Compare the extracted catalogs
steps.instructions: Run the new extractor and review the diff against the existing catalogs, keeping keys, ordering, and metadata stable.

verification.purpose: Build the translations with the new extractor.
Run the repository tests when defined.
